responsibility: Shared implementation template behind GNAT’s VxWorks crtbegin variants. It defines the common .eh_frame sentinel object, the exported VxWorks-muncher-friendly constructor/destructor symbol names, and the actual routines that register and deregister DWARF frame information with GCC’s unwinder through __register_frame_info and __deregister_frame_info. The surrounding .c variants supply only the invocation strategy via attributes or section placement; this include file owns the core EH-frame registration logic itself.
same_name_distinction: This .inc file differs from vx_crtbegin.c by being the reusable implementation body rather than a standalone variant source: it contains the shared EH-frame anchor, exported VxWorks constructor/destructor symbol definitions, and the register/deregister routines that vx_crtbegin.c instantiates after choosing the wrapper attributes.
